# Photo/Video Browser Frontend Project

This is a modern Node.js photo/video browser frontend converted from a PHP application. The project maintains all original functionality while modernizing the technology stack.

## Key Features to Maintain
- Mosaic grid layout for photos and videos
- Breadcrumb navigation with previous/next directory support
- Modal lightbox with slideshow functionality
- Tag management system
- Video and image thumbnail handling
- Directory browsing capabilities

## Technology Stack
- **Backend**: Express.js server for API endpoints and static file serving
- **Frontend**: Vanilla JavaScript with modern ES6+ modules
- **Styling**: CSS Grid/Flexbox for responsive layouts
- **Media Handling**: HTML5 video/image elements with custom controls

## Code Style Guidelines
- Use modern ES6+ JavaScript features (async/await, modules, destructuring)
- Implement responsive design patterns
- Follow REST API conventions for backend endpoints
- Use semantic HTML and accessible markup
- Implement proper error handling and loading states
- Maintain separation of concerns between modules

## Original PHP Features to Replicate
- Directory scanning and metadata extraction
- Thumbnail generation for images and videos
- Breadcrumb navigation with parent/child relationships
- Modal slideshow with keyboard navigation
- Tag display and management
- File deletion and download capabilities
- Responsive mosaic layout that adapts to content
